onboarding.title: Your home, under control
onboarding.subtitle: HomeCare keeps maintenance, equipment, warranties, bills and documents in one calm place.

maintenance.title: Never miss maintenance
maintenance.body: Plan recurring tasks with 60+ editable templates and gentle reminders.

assets.title: Know your equipment
assets.body: Brands, models, serial numbers, warranties and repair history.

documents.title: Find any document
documents.body: Invoices, manuals, contracts and insurance, stored privately on your phone.

expenses.title: Follow home spending
expenses.body: Bills, recurring costs and a monthly budget, in your currency.

onboarding.privacy: No account needed. Your data stays on this device.
onboarding.notificationsHint: Maintenance due, warranties ending, bills and chores. You can change this anytime.
onboarding.analyticsHint: Helps us improve the app. Never includes your documents, names or amounts. Off by default.
onboarding.dataPromise: Your documents and data are never uploaded automatically. Back up whenever you want from Settings.

dashboard.allGood: All clear — nothing urgent at home.

homes.title: My homes
homes.subtitle: Switch between homes or add another one.
homes.deleteMessage: The home and everything in it (equipment, tasks, documents, expenses) will be deleted from this device.
homes.lastMessage: To erase everything, use Settings > Backup & data > Delete all my data.

rooms.empty: No spaces yet. Add your rooms to organise equipment and tasks.

rooms.noAssets: No equipment in this space yet.

assets.title: Equipment
assets.subtitle: Appliances, systems and devices
assets.emptyMessage: Keep brand, model, serial number and warranty at hand when you need a repair.
assets.deleteMessage: Its maintenance tasks, repairs and documents are kept but no longer linked.
assets.repairPrompt: Record the problem and the technician to keep the equipment history complete.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.emptyMessage: Start from a template (filters, boiler, smoke detectors…) and adjust the interval to your home.
maintenance.deleteMessage: The task and its history will be deleted.
maintenance.addAsExpense: Also add the cost to expenses
maintenance.oneOffDone: One-off task: it will be marked as completed.

templates.title: Maintenance templates
templates.subtitle: {{count}} editable starting points
templates.disclaimer: Suggested intervals are general organisation presets, not technical recommendations. Always follow the manufacturer's instructions and local regulations, and use a qualified professional for gas, electrical and safety work.
templates.intervalHint: Choose the interval that suits your equipment and its manual.

ac_filter_clean.title: Clean air-conditioner filters
ac_filter_clean.desc: Remove, vacuum or rinse the filters and let them dry before refitting.

ac_service.title: Air-conditioning service
ac_service.desc: Professional check of refrigerant, drainage and electrical parts.

ac_outdoor_unit.title: Clear the outdoor AC unit
ac_outdoor_unit.desc: Remove leaves and debris around the outdoor unit; keep airflow free.

boiler_service.title: Boiler service
boiler_service.desc: Annual service by a qualified technician; keep the certificate in Documents.

boiler_pressure.title: Check boiler pressure
boiler_pressure.desc: Read the pressure gauge and compare with the range in the manual.

radiator_bleed.title: Bleed radiators
radiator_bleed.desc: Release trapped air before the heating season.

heating_check.title: Heating system check
heating_check.desc: Test thermostats and radiators before winter.

vmc_vents_clean.title: Clean ventilation vents
vmc_vents_clean.desc: Dust the extract vents in kitchen and bathrooms.

chimney_sweep.title: Chimney sweeping
chimney_sweep.desc: Have the flue swept by a professional and keep the certificate.

thermostat_battery.title: Replace thermostat batteries
thermostat_battery.desc: Avoid losing heating schedules when batteries run out.

water_heater_flush.title: Flush the water heater
water_heater_flush.desc: Drain some water to remove sediment, following the manual.

water_heater_anode.title: Inspect water-heater anode
water_heater_anode.desc: Check the sacrificial anode; replace it if heavily worn.

drains_clean.title: Clean drains
drains_clean.desc: Remove hair and debris from sink and shower drains.

leak_check.title: Check for leaks
leak_check.desc: Look under sinks, around toilets and appliances for drips or damp.

main_valve_test.title: Test the main water valve
main_valve_test.desc: Make sure you can close it quickly in an emergency.

faucet_aerators.title: Descale faucet aerators
faucet_aerators.desc: Unscrew and soak aerators to restore water flow.

toilet_check.title: Check toilets
toilet_check.desc: Look for running water and worn seals.

shower_head_descale.title: Descale shower heads
shower_head_descale.desc: Soak in vinegar or descaler to clear limescale.

water_softener_salt.title: Refill water-softener salt
water_softener_salt.desc: Top up the salt tank when it runs low.

sump_pump_test.title: Test the sump pump
sump_pump_test.desc: Pour water into the pit and check the pump starts.

fridge_clean.title: Clean the refrigerator
fridge_clean.desc: Empty, wash shelves and seals, discard expired food.

fridge_coils.title: Dust refrigerator coils
fridge_coils.desc: Unplug and vacuum the condenser coils at the back or bottom.

freezer_defrost.title: Defrost the freezer
freezer_defrost.desc: Defrost when ice builds up (not needed for no-frost models).

fridge_water_filter.title: Replace fridge water filter
fridge_water_filter.desc: For fridges with water dispensers or ice makers.

washer_drum_clean.title: Clean the washing-machine drum
washer_drum_clean.desc: Run an empty hot cycle or a drum-clean programme.

washer_filter.title: Clean the washer pump filter
washer_filter.desc: Drain and clean the filter to avoid blockages and odours.

washer_hoses.title: Inspect washer hoses
washer_hoses.desc: Look for cracks or bulges in the inlet hoses.

dryer_vent.title: Clean the dryer vent
dryer_vent.desc: Clear lint from the duct to reduce fire risk.

dishwasher_filter.title: Clean the dishwasher filter
dishwasher_filter.desc: Rinse the filter and check the spray arms.

dishwasher_descale.title: Descale the dishwasher
dishwasher_descale.desc: Run a descaling cycle; check salt and rinse aid.

oven_clean.title: Clean the oven
oven_clean.desc: Clean the cavity, racks and door glass.

range_hood_filter.title: Clean range-hood filters
range_hood_filter.desc: Wash grease filters; replace carbon filters as needed.

kettle_coffee_descale.title: Descale kettle and coffee maker
kettle_coffee_descale.desc: Remove limescale for better taste and efficiency.

microwave_clean.title: Clean the microwave
microwave_clean.desc: Steam-clean the inside and wipe the door seal.

smoke_detector_test.title: Test smoke detectors
smoke_detector_test.desc: Press the test button on every detector.

smoke_detector_battery.title: Replace smoke-detector batteries
smoke_detector_battery.desc: Replace batteries and note the detector's expiry date.

co_detector_test.title: Test carbon-monoxide detectors
co_detector_test.desc: Press the test button; check the expiry date.

fire_extinguisher_check.title: Check fire extinguishers
fire_extinguisher_check.desc: Check the pressure gauge and the service date.

rcd_test.title: Test the RCD / GFCI
rcd_test.desc: Press the test button on the residual-current device.

electrical_inspection.title: Electrical inspection
electrical_inspection.desc: Inspection of the installation by a qualified electrician.

outdoor_lights.title: Check outdoor lighting
outdoor_lights.desc: Replace bulbs and test timers and sensors.

gutters_clean.title: Clean gutters
gutters_clean.desc: Remove leaves and check downpipes flow freely. Work safely at height.

roof_inspection.title: Roof inspection
roof_inspection.desc: Look for missing tiles or damage from the ground or by a professional.

facade_check.title: Check walls and facade
facade_check.desc: Look for cracks, damp patches and damaged render.

window_seals.title: Check window seals
window_seals.desc: Inspect seals and joints to prevent drafts and leaks.

deck_treatment.title: Treat the deck or terrace
deck_treatment.desc: Clean and apply protective treatment to wood.

garage_door_lube.title: Lubricate the garage door
garage_door_lube.desc: Lubricate rails and hinges; test the safety reverse.

lawn_mow.title: Mow the lawn
lawn_mow.desc: Adjust the height to the season.

hedge_trim.title: Trim hedges
hedge_trim.desc: Check local rules on nesting periods before cutting.

garden_tools.title: Maintain garden tools
garden_tools.desc: Clean, sharpen and oil tools before storing them.

pool_water_check.title: Check pool water
pool_water_check.desc: Test pH and treatment levels; clean the skimmer.

mower_service.title: Service the lawn mower
mower_service.desc: Blade, oil, air filter and spark plug as per the manual.

deep_clean.title: Deep clean
deep_clean.desc: Behind furniture, baseboards, light fittings and cupboards.

mattress_rotate.title: Rotate mattresses
mattress_rotate.desc: Rotate or flip according to the manufacturer.

grout_seal.title: Check grout and seal
grout_seal.desc: Re-seal tile grout in wet areas when needed.

caulk_check.title: Check silicone joints
caulk_check.desc: Replace mouldy or cracked silicone around bath and sink.

vacuum_filter.title: Clean vacuum filters
vacuum_filter.desc: Empty the bin and wash or replace filters.

pest_check.title: Pest check
pest_check.desc: Look for signs of insects or rodents in storage areas.

emergency_supplies.title: Check emergency supplies
emergency_supplies.desc: Torch, batteries, water and important contacts.

household.emptyMessage: Add daily chores like laundry, trash day or watering the plants.

members.title: Household members
members.hint: Optional names to assign chores. They stay on this device — no accounts, nothing is shared.
members.name: Name
members.addHint: Add household members to assign chores
members.deleteMessage: Chores assigned to this person become unassigned.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Invoices, warranties, contracts and manuals
documents.emptyMessage: Import invoices, warranties, manuals and contracts from your phone. They stay private on this device.
documents.noFileYet: No file attached. You can also keep a record of a paper document.
documents.privateCopy: A private copy is stored inside HomeCare. It is never uploaded.
documents.reminderLocked: Choose when to be reminded before expiry with Premium (default: 30 days).
documents.deleteMessage: The document and its private file copy will be deleted.

photos.title: Photos
photos.deleteMessage: The photo will be removed from HomeCare.
photos.cameraDenied: Allow camera access in Android settings, or choose a photo from your gallery.
photos.error: The photo could not be added.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.multiCurrency: Amounts in different currencies are shown separately and never added together.
expenses.statsLocked: 12-month trends and yearly comparisons with Premium
expenses.emptyMessage: Add bills, repairs and purchases to see where your home budget goes.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.subtitle: Bills and subscriptions
recurring.hint: Due occurrences are added to your expenses automatically (you can turn this off per bill) and you get a reminder before each one.
recurring.emptyMessage: Add electricity, internet, insurance or any bill that repeats.
recurring.pastStart: Payments since the first date will be added to your expenses (up to 36).
recurring.autoRecordHint: When a payment date passes, the expense is recorded with this amount.

repairs.title: Repairs & services
repairs.subtitle: Problems, interventions and technicians
repairs.emptyMessage: Log breakdowns and interventions to keep a full history of your equipment.
repairs.warrantyTip: Keep the invoice and warranty in Documents and mention them to the technician.

inventory.title: Home inventory
inventory.subtitle: Valuable items, for insurance and moving
inventory.emptyMessage: List valuable items with photos and value — useful for insurance claims and moving.

history.title: Intervention history
history.unlock: See your complete history with Premium

validation.titleAndAmount: Enter a title and an amount
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the first payment.
validation.warrantyBeforePurchase: The warranty end is before the purchase date.
validation.futureCompletion: The completion date can't be in the future.

hints.maintenance: Before a maintenance task is due

hints.household: On the due day, and the next day if not done

notifications.testBody: You'll be notified like this when something needs attention.

warranty_expiring.body: The warranty ends on {{date}}. Check the equipment before it expires.

data.localOnly: Everything is stored on this phone only. HomeCare has no server and never uploads your data.
data.backupHint: Create a backup file and save it where you choose (Drive, e-mail, computer). Restore it on this or another phone.
data.restoreWarning: All current HomeCare data on this phone will be replaced by the backup.

restoreErrors.invalid_json: This file is not a valid backup.
restoreErrors.invalid_format: This file is not a HomeCare backup.
restoreErrors.wrong_app: This backup belongs to another app.
restoreErrors.newer_schema: This backup was made with a newer version of HomeCare. Update the app first.
restoreErrors.unknown: The backup could not be restored. Your current data was not changed.

data.filesNotIncluded: The backup contains your data, not the files themselves (documents and photos). Share important files individually from their screen.
data.exportLocked: Export equipment, inventory and expenses to PDF or CSV with Premium.
data.deleteHint: Erase every home, document, photo and setting from this phone. Your Google Play subscription is not affected.
data.deleteWarning: This permanently erases all homes, equipment, documents, photos and history from this phone. It can't be undone.
data.failed: The operation failed. Please try again.

local.title: Stored on your phone
local.body: Homes, equipment, documents, photos and expenses are saved in HomeCare's private storage on this device.

noUpload.title: Nothing uploaded
noUpload.body: HomeCare has no server. Files leave your phone only when you share or export them yourself.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.body: You don't need to sign up. Household members are just local names.

ads.title: Ads and consent
ads.body: The free version shows small banners on list screens, never on documents or while completing a task. Ads never receive your documents or data. In regions where it's required, you choose your consent.

permissions.title: Minimal permissions
permissions.body: Notifications for reminders, and the camera only when you take a photo. Files are picked with the system picker, without storage permission.

delete.title: You stay in control
delete.body: Export a backup or delete all data anytime in Settings > Backup & data.

privacy.analyticsHint: Off by default. Only counts like "a task was completed", never names, notes, amounts or files.
